dataset_info.notes: Voice-assistant utterances from OVOS intents-for-eval reused as a multilingual TTS read-aloud prompt set. TTS has no objective metric — fighters synthesise each prompt and the clips are assembled into blind A/B listening battles (human votes only, no benchmark board, no ELO seed). Cap with --max-samples for manageable battle pools.
